# pve_apt_standard_repository (Resource)

Enables or disables one standard APT repository (`enterprise`, `no-subscription`, `test`, `ceph-squid-no-subscription`, …) on a node. Enabling calls `PUT /nodes/{node}/apt/repositories` (`add_repository`), which enables an existing disabled entry or writes a new one. Disabling sets `enabled=0` on every enabled `/etc/apt` entry that matches the repository's URI and component. Use `for_each` to manage several repositories.

Setting `enabled = false` on a repository that is not configured does nothing. Destroying the resource disables the repository. Entries pointing at a local mirror cannot be matched, so the provider cannot disable them.

Import with `<node>/<handle>`, for example `pve1/no-subscription`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_apt_standard_repository" "no_subscription" {
  node   = "pve1"
  handle = "no-subscription"
}

resource "pve_apt_standard_repository" "enterprise" {
  node    = "pve1"
  handle  = "enterprise"
  enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `handle` (String) Standard repository handle, for example `enterprise`, `no-subscription`, `test` or `ceph-squid-no-subscription`. The node's `standard_repos` (see the `pve_apt_repositories` data source) lists the offered handles.
- `node` (String) Node whose APT configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the repository is enabled. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<node>/<handle>`.
- `name` (String) Full repository name reported by the node.
